English: A novel environmental nano-catalyst based on zeolite (ZE) adjusted with carbon nanotube (CNT)/silver nanoparticles (AgNPS) ornamented carbon paste electrode (CPE) is used for electrochemical oxidation of propylene glycol (PG) in 0.5 M H2SO4 solution.
Luganda: Nano-catalyst ey’obutonde empya eyeesigamiziddwa ku zeolite (ZE) ng’ekyusiddwamu ne carbon nanotube (CNT)/silver nanoparticles (AgNPS) ornamented carbon paste electrode (CPE) ekozesebwa okussa n’amasannyalaze g’omukka ogussibwa mu propylene glycol (PG) mu mazzi ga 0.5 M H2SO4.
Yoruba: Èròjà amúṣedánwòlé-bíntín ajẹmáwùjọ tuntun tó gùn lé síyóláìtì (ZE) wíth wọ́n fi túùbù-bíntín aláfẹ́fẹ́ kábọ́ọ̀nù (CNT)/ èérún-bíntín fàdákà (AgNPS) àpòpọ̀ ẹ̀bẹ̀ àmúṣètò-iná (CPE) ni wọ́n lò fún àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà onínàmọ̀nàmọ́ná ti kẹ́míkà aṣètúká (PG) nínú ìpòpọ̀ 0.5 M H2SO4.
Zulu: Inoveli yemvelo ye-nano-catalyst egxilekwi-zeolite (ZE) elungiswe nge-carbon nanotube (CNT)/silver nanoparticles (AgNPS) ehlotshiswe nge-carbon paste electrode (CPE) isetshenziselwa i-electrochemical oxidation ye-propylene glycol (PG) kwingxube engu-0.5 M H2SO4.
Hausa: Ana amfani da wani sabon nano-catalyst na muhalli bisa zaulayit (ZE) da aka gyara tare da raga (CNT)/ɓangarori na azurfa (AgNPS) ornamented carbon paste na kwandakta (CPE) don ƙona electrochemical h na propylene glycol (PG) a bayanin 0.5 M H2SO4.
Northern Sotho: Go potlakišwa go gonnyanenyane ga zeolaete tikologong ye mpsha (ZE) ye e fetošitšwego ka nanotšhupu tša khapone (CNT)/dikarolwana tše nnyanenyane tša silibera (AgNPS) elekthereoute ya motswako wa khapone wo o kgabišitšwego (CPE) e šomišetšwa oksideitšene ya elektherokhemikhale ya propylene glycol (PG) go motswako wa 0.5 M H2SO4.
Amharic: በዚዎላይት (ZE) ላይ መሰረት ያደረገ አዲስ የአካባቢ ናኖ ተንኳሽ ከካርቦን ናኖ ቀሰም (ካ.ና.ቀ)/በብር ናኖ ቅንጣቶች (AgNPS) ያጌጠ ካርቦን ቅብ ኤሌክትሮድ (ካ.ቅ.ኤ) ጋር ተስተካክሎ ለፕሮፒሊን ግላይኮል (ፕ.ግ) ኤሌክትሪክ ግብአተ ኦክስጂን በ0.5 M H2SO4 ቅይጥ ውስጥ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል።

English: The techniques like cyclic voltammetry (CV), chronoamperometry (CA) and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) are utilized to achieve the catalytic performance.
Luganda: Obukodyo nga cyclic voltammetry (CV), chronoamperometry (CA) ne electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) bukozesebwa okulaba nga catalyst ekola bulungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìlànà bíi ìṣòdiwọ̀n kẹ́míkà onínàmọ̀nàmọ́ná(CV), ìṣèdámọ̀ àti ìṣàyẹ̀wò kẹ́míkà (CA) àti ìtúpalẹ̀ àkóónú iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná (EIS) ni wọ́n lò láti jèrè ìṣesí ìsọdohun-ìlò.
Zulu: Amasu afana ne-cyclic voltammetry (CV), i-chronoamperometry (CA) kanye ne-electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) asetshenziselwa ukufeza ukusebenza kwesilinganisi.
Hausa: Ana amfani da dabaru irin su cyclic voltammetry (CV) da chronoamperometry (CA) da kuma electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) domin cim ma nasarar aikin ƙara kuzari.
Northern Sotho: Mekgwa ye e swanago le cyclic voltammetry (CV), chronoamperometry (CA) le electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) e šomišetšwa go fihlelela phethagatšo ya potlakišo.
Amharic: እንደ ኡደታዊ ቮልታሜትሪ (ኡ.ቮ)፣ ክሮኖአምፐሮሜትሪ (ክ.አ) እና የኤሌክትሪካዊ ኬሚካል ስፔክትሮስኮፒ እግዶሽ (ኤ.ኬ.ስ.እ) የመሳሰሉት ዘዴዎች የመተንኮስ ክንውኑን ለማሳካት ጥቅም ላይ ይውላሉ።

English: Surface characteristics are achieved by means of Scanning electron microscopic (SEM) and Energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDX) techniques.
Luganda: Obufaanane obw’okungulu bufunibwa mu kukozesa enkola za Scanning electron microscopic (SEM) ne Energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDX).
Yoruba: Wọ́n jèrè ìrísí ìlò nípá Ṣísàmúlò ẹ̀rọ awágbára-iná (SEM) àti ìlànà ìtúpalẹ̀ ajẹmọ́ wíwo àkóónú kẹ́míkà (EDX).
Zulu: Izici ezingaphezulu zitholwa ngokusebenzisa i-Scanning electron microscopic (SEM) kanye namasu okuhlaziya e-Energy dispersive X-ray (EDX).
Hausa: Ana samun halayen saman ta hanyar Scanning microscopic electron (SEM) da kuma fasahar tarwatsawar Makamashi ta X-ray (EDX).
Northern Sotho: Dipharologantšho tša pepeneneng di fihlelelwa ka tsela ya Go sekena maekherosekopiki ya elekthereone (SEM) le dithekniki tša tshekatsheko ya X-rei ya phatlalatšo ya Enetši (EDX).
Amharic: የወለል ባህሪያት በማይክሮስኮፒያዊ የኤሌክትሮኖች ቅኝት (ማ.ኤ.ቅ) እና የሃይል መበታተን ትንተና በኤክስሬይ (ሃ.መ.ት.ኤ) ዘዴዎች ይገኛሉ።

English: Enhancing the loading magnitude of CNT into catalyst's ingredient can meaningfully develop the catalytic activity of the electrocatalyst towards propylene oxidation.
Luganda: Okwongera ku buzito bwa CNT mu bikola catalyst kisobola okwongerera ddala ku bukozi bwa catalyst obwa electrocatalyst eri propylene oxidation.
Yoruba: Jíjẹ́ kí ìdìkún ti CNT nínú àwọn èròjà amúṣedánwòlé lè mú ìdàgbàsókè tó ní ìtumọ̀ gidi bá ìṣe ajẹmámúṣedánwòlé ti amúṣedánwò agbára iná yá nípa aṣètúká ìgbanámọ̀nàmọ́ná.
Zulu: Ukuthuthukisa ubukhulu bokulayisha kwe-CNT kwisithako sesilinganisi kungathuthukisa ngokunengqondo umsebenzi wesilinganisi se-electrocatalyst ibheke kwi-propylene oxidation.
Hausa: Haɓaka girman lodin CNT zuwa cikin sinadarin mai ƙara kuzari na iya haɓaka kuzarin lantarki mai ma’ana zuwa ƙona propylene.
Northern Sotho: Go kaonafatša go loutwa ga bogolo bja CNT ka go motswako wa potlakišo go ka hlabolla tsela ye e bonagalago mošomo wa potlakišo ka elekthero go fihlelela oksideitšene ya propylene.
Amharic: የካ.ና.ቀን የመጫን አቅም ወደ ተንኳሽ ንጥረ ነገር ውስጥ መጨመር የኤሌክትሪካዊ ተንኳሹን የመተንኮስ እንቅስቃሴ የፕሮፒሊንን ግብአተ ኦክሲጂንን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ሊያሳድገው ይችላል።

English: The impact of altering the concentration of propylene glycol and the scanning rate on the resulting electrocatalyst performance during the oxidation cycle is considered.
Luganda: Ebireetebwa okukyusa obukole bwa propylene glycol n’omutindo gw’okwetegereza enkola ya electrocatalyst mu mwetooloolo gw’okussaamu omukka ogussibwa bitunuulirwa.
Yoruba: Ipa ṣíṣe àyípadà ìdágún kémíkà aṣètúká àti ìpele àyẹ̀wò tí ó ara àbájáde amúṣedánwò agbára iná yá yọ lásìkò àyíká ìgbaná náà jẹ́ ohun tí wọ́n dàrò.
Zulu: Umthelela wokushintsha ukushuba kwe-propylene glycol kanye nezinga lokubheka umphumela ekusebenzeni kwe-electrocatalyst phakathi nomjikelezo we-oxidation uyacatshangelwa.
Hausa: An yi la’akari da tasirin sauya taruwa na propylene glycol da ƙimar dubawa a kan sakamakon electrocatalyst a lokacin sake zagayowar ƙonawa.
Northern Sotho: Seabe sa go fetoša motswakotia wa propylene glycol le kelo ya go sekena ya go tšweletša phethagatšo ya potlakišo ya elektro nakong ya saekele ya oksideitšene e a akanywa.
Amharic: በግብአተ ኦክሲጂን ኡደት ወቅት የፕሮፒሊን ግላይኮልን የክምችት ልክ እና የኤሌክትሪካዊ ተንኳሹን የክንውን ውጤት የቅኝት ደረጃ መለወጥ የሚያስከትለው ተጽእኖ ከግምት ውስጥ ገብቷል።

English: Chronoamperograms present an amplify of the steady state oxidation current density values after addition of these nano-catalysts.
Luganda: Chronoamperograms zireetawo okweyongera kw’emiwendo egiriwo egy’obungi bw’omukka ogussibwa oluvannyuma lw’okuteekamu nano-catalyst zino.
Yoruba: Ìlànà dídín agbára iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná kù ṣe àgbékalẹ̀ ìlọtààrà ipò ìgbaná lẹ́yìn ṣíṣe àfikún àwọn èròjà amúṣedánwòlé-bíntín wọ̀nyí.
Zulu: Ama-Chronoamerograms athula ukukhuliswa kwamanani amanje e-oxidation esimo sokuminyana ngemuva kokwengezwa kwalawa ma-nano-catalyst.
Hausa: Chronoamperograms suna ba da haɓaka ƙimar ƙonawa na yau da kullum a tsaye bayan ƙari na waɗannan nano-catalysts.
Northern Sotho: Chronoamperograms di fana ka boleng bja teteano ya bjale ya oksiteitšene ya seemo se fetogago gannyane morago ga go tsenywa ga dipotlakišo tše tše nnyanenyane.
Amharic: እነዚህ ናኖ ተንኳሾች ከታከሉ በኋላ ያለውን የተረጋጋ የግብአተ ኦክሲጅን የዥረት እፍጋት ስሌቶችን ሁኔታ ክሮኖአምፔሮግራሞች አጉልተው ያሳያሉ።

English: A promising catalytic stability of nano-catalyst has been achieved in electing its use for propylene glycol electro-oxidation in fuel cells applications.
Luganda: Waliwo essuubi erituukiddwako ery’obutebenkevu bwa nano-catalyst mu nkozesa yaazo mu propylene glycol electro-oxidation mu bikozesa amanda g’amafuta.
Yoruba: Ìmúdúró ajẹmọ́ èròjà amúṣedánwòlé tí ó jẹ́ ti èròjà amúṣedánwòlé-bíntín ti di ṣíṣe nípa yíyan ìlò rẹ̀ fún kẹ́míkà aṣètúká èròjà aṣèyàtọ̀ ìgbáná nínú ìlò àwọn hóró epo.
Zulu: Ukuzinza okuthembisayo kwe-nano-catalyst kuzuzwe ekukhethweni ukusetshenziswa kwayo kwe-propylene glycol electro-oxidation ekusetshenzisweni kumaseli kaphethiloli.
Hausa: An sami kwanciyar hankali mai ƙarfi na nano-catalyst a zaɓen amfani da shi don ƙona lantarki na propylene glycol a sanya ƙwayoyin mai.
Northern Sotho: Go fihleletšwe go tielela ga go potlakišwa ga khemikhale go gonnyanenyane go go holofetšago ge go kgethwa tšhomišo ya sona ya propylene glycol ya oksiteitšene ya elekthero go ditšweletšwa tša disele tša makhura.
Amharic: በነዳጅ ሴሎች አጠቃቀም ውስጥ ለፕሮፒሊን ግላይኮል ኤሌክትሪካዊ ግብአተ ኦክሲጂን ጥቅም ላይ እንዲውል የናኖ ተንኳሽን በመምረጥ ተሰፋ ሰጪ የተንኳሽ መረጋጋት ላይ ተደርሷል።

English: They found that adding tiny silver particles and tiny carbon tubes to an existing catalyst significantly speeds up a chemical reaction involved in releasing energy from fuels.

Yoruba: Wọ́n ríi pé ṣíṣàfikún àwọn èérún-bíntín fàdákà àti àwọn túùbù aláfẹ́fẹ́ kábọ́ọ̀nù mọ́ èròjà amúṣedánwòlé tí ó ti wà tẹ́lè láti túnbọ̀ mú kí àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà tí ó wà lára gbígba agbára-ìṣe láti ara àwọn epo yá kánmọ́.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi ukwengeza izinhlayiya zesiliva ezincane namashubhu e-carbon amancane kwisilinganisi esikhona kusheshisa kakhulu ukusabela kwamakhemikhali abandakanyeka ekukhipheni amandla kumafutha.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa ƙara ƙananan ƙwayoyin azurfa da ƙananan bututun kabon zuwa abubuwan da ke faruwa suna da matuƙar saurin haɓakar da amsawar sinadarai da suke cikin sakin makamashi daga mai.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore ka go tšhela dikarolwana tše nnyane tša silibera le ditšhupu tša khapone tše nnyanenyane go potlakišo ye e lego gona e potlakiša go fetišiša phetogo ya khemikhale ye e amegago go lokolleng enetši go tšwa go makhura.
Amharic: ጥቃቅን የብር ቅንጣቶችን እና ጥቃቅን የካርቦን ቀሰሞችን ወደ ነባር ተንኳሾቹ ማከል ከነዳጅ ሃይልን ለመልቀቅ የሚደረገውን ኬሚካላዊ አፀግብሮት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንደሚያፋጥነው ደርሰውበታል።

English: Electricity from fuel cells is cleaner and more environmentally-friendly compared to electricity from fossil fuels, which contribute to climate change.
Luganda: Amasannyalaze agava mu manda g’amafuta mayonjo era gakuuma obutonde okusinga ku masannyalaze agava mu mafuta agasimwa, ekyongera ku kukyusa embeera y’obudde.
Yoruba: Iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná ti ara àwọn hóró-epo mọ́, ó sì bá àyíká rẹ́ bí a bá ṣàfiwé rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú epo abẹ́mì, èyí tí ó ń dákún àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́.
Zulu: Ugesi ophuma kumaseli kagesi uhlanzekile futhi uhambisana nemvelo uma uqhathaniswa nogesi ovela emandleni ezibaseli ezimbiwa phansi, anomthelela ekushintsheni kwesimo sezulu.
Hausa: Wutar lantarki daga sel na mai ta fi tsabta kuma ta fi dacewa da muhalli idan aka kwatanta da wutar lantarki daga ɓurɓushin mai, wanda yake taimakawa wajen sauyin yanayi.
Northern Sotho: Mohlagase wo o tšwago diseleng tša makhura o hlwekile gabotse le go lokela tikologo ge o bapetšwa le mohlagase wo o tšwago makhureng a fosili, wo o bakago phetogo ya klaemete.
Amharic: ከነዳጅ ሴሎች የሚገኘው የኤሌክትሪክ ሃይል ከቅሪተ አካል ከሚገኘው የኤሌክትሪክ ሃይል ይልቅ ንጹህ እና ለአካባቢም ተስማሚ ሲሆን ይህም ለአየር ንብረት ለውጥ አስተዋጽኦ ያደርጋል።

English: Researchers all over the world are constantly looking for ways to improve fuel cells, including ways to speed up the chemical reactions that happen inside of them.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza mu nsi yonna banoonya engeri z’okulongoosaamu amanda g’amafuta, nga kw’otadde n’engeri z’okwanguya ku ebyo ebibaawo munda mu bwo.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí kárí-ayé ń wà ọ̀nà láti ṣe ìgbépẹ́ẹ́lí àwọn hóró-epo, lára rẹ̀ ni wíwá àwọn ọ̀nà láti mú kí àwọn àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà tí ó ń wáyé nínú wọn yá kánmọ́.
Zulu: Abacwaningi emhlabeni wonke bahlala befuna izindlela zokuthuthukisa amaseli kagesi, kuhlanganise nezindlela zokusheshisa ukusabela kwamakhemikhali enzeka ngaphakathi kwawo.
Hausa: Masu bincike a duk faɗin duniya suna ci gaba da neman hanyoyin inganta ƙwayoyin mai, gami da hanyoyin hanzarta amsawar sinadaran da suke faruwa a cikin su.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši lefaseng ka bophara ba dula ba nyakana le ditsela tša go kaonafatša disele tša makhura, go akaretšwa ditsela tša go potlakiša phetogo ya khemikhale tšeo di hlagago ka gare ga tšona.
Amharic: በመላው አለም የሚገኙ ተመራማሪዎች የነዳጅ ሴሎችን ለማሻሻል በውስጣቸው የሚከናወኑትን ኬሚካላዊ አፀግብሮቶች ለማፋጠን የሚያስችሉ መንገዶችን ጨምሮ አለማቋረጥ ይፈልጋሉ።

English: Materials that speed up such chemical reactions are called catalysts.
Luganda: Ebintu ebyanguya enkola ezo biyitibwa catalysts.
Yoruba: Àwọn èròjà tí wọ́n ń mú kí irú àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà bẹ́ẹ̀ yá kánmọ́ ni wọ́n ń pè ní èròjà amúṣedánwòyá.
Zulu: Izinto ezisheshisa ukusabela kwamakhemikhali okunjalo zibizwa ngokuthi izilinganisi.
Hausa: Abubuwan da suke hanzarta irin waɗannan amsawar sinadarai ana kiransu masu ƙara kuzari.
Northern Sotho: Didirišwa tše di potlakišago phetogo yeo ya khemikhale di bitšwa dipotlakiši.
Amharic: እንዲህ ያሉ ኬሚካላዊ አፀግብሮቶችን የሚያፋጥኑ ቁሳቁሶች ተንኳሾች ይባላሉ።

English: Researchers wanted to know if nanomaterials, like incredibly tiny carbon nanotubes and silver nanoparticles, would improve the performance of a common catalyst known as zeolite.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayagala okumanya oba nga nanomaterials, okugeza obuseke bwa kaboni obusirikitu n’obutundutundu bwa feeza, bisobola okwanguya ku nkola za catalyst eza bulijjo eziyitibwa zeolite.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí fẹ́ mọ̀ bóyá àwọn èròjà-bíntín, bíi àwọn túùbù-bíntín aláfẹ́fẹ́ kábọ́ọ̀nù tí ó bíntín gan-an àti àwọn èérún-bíntín fàdákà, yóò ṣe ìgbépẹ́ẹ́lí èròjà amúṣedánwòyá tí ó wọ́pọ̀ kan tí a mọ̀ sí síyóláìtì.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bebefuna ukwazi ukuthi ingabe ama-nanomaterials, njengama-carbon nanotubes amancane nama-silver nanoparticles, angathuthukisa ukusebenza kwesilinganisi esivamile esaziwa ngokuthi i-zeolite.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun so su sani idan nanomaterials, kamar ƙananan raga da ɓangarori na azurfa, za su inganta aikin mai ƙara kuzari da aka sani da suna zaulayit.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go tseba ge e ba dimateriale tše nnyanenyane, tše di swanago le ditšhupu tša khapone tše nnyanenyane le dikarolwana tše nnyanenyane tša silibere, di ka kaonafatša go šoma ga sepotlakišakhemikhale se se tlwaelegilego sa go tsebega bjalo ka zeolaete.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች እጅጉን ጥቃቅን የሆኑ የካርቦን ናኖ ቀሰሞችን እና የብር ናኖ ቅንጣቶችን የመሳሰሉ የናኖ ቁሳቁሶች ዚዎላይት የተባለውን የተለመደ ተንኳሽ ክዋኔ ያሻሽሉ እንደሆን ማወቅ ፈልገዋል።

English: They mixed the nanomaterials in various combinations with the zeolite, and used advanced techniques, including a powerful microscope, to ensure that the materials would work as catalysts.
Luganda: Bagatta ebintu bino eby’enjawulo ne zeolite, ne bakozesa obukodyo obw’ekikugu, omuli ekizimbulukusa eky’amaanyi, okulaba ng’ebintu bino bisobola okukola nga catalysts.
Yoruba: Wọ́n po àwọn èròjà-aṣàyẹ̀wò-bíntín sínú onírúnrú àkàpọ̀ pẹ̀lú síyóláìtì, wọ́n sì ṣàmúlò àwọn ìlànà tó tayọ tí ẹ̀rọ awokòkòrò tí ó lágbára jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára wọn, láti ríi dájú pé àwọn èròjà náà yóọl siṣẹ́ amúṣedánwòyá.
Zulu: Baxube ama-nanomaterials ngezinhlanganisela ezihlukahlukene ne-zeolite, futhi basebenzisa amasu athuthukile, okuhlanganisa nesibonakhulu esinamandla, ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izinto zizosebenza njengezilinganisi ezisheshayo.
Hausa: Sun haɗa nanomaterials a haɗuwa daban-daban tare da zaulayit, kuma sun yi amfani da ingantacciyar fasaha, ciki har da na’ura mai mahimmanci, don tabbatar da cewa kayan za su yi aiki a matsayin mai ƙara kuzari.
Northern Sotho: Ba hlakantše dimateriale tše nnyanenyane ka metswako ye e fapafapanego le zeolaete, le go šomiša mekgwa ye e gatetšego pele, go akaretša maekhrosekoupu o maatla, go kgonthiša gore didirišwa di šoma bjalo ka dipotlakiši.
Amharic: ቁሳቁሶቹ እንደ ተንኳሽ መስራታቸውን ለማረጋገጥ ናኖ ቁሳቁሶቹን በተለያዩ ጥምረቶች ከዚዎላይት ጋር የቀላቀሉ ሲሆን ሃይለኛ ማይክሮስኮፕን ጨምሮ የላቁ ቴክኒኮችንም ተጠቅመዋል።

English: They then attached each catalyst to an electrode, which is an electrical conductor that moves (conducts) electrons generated by a chemical reaction, in order to produce electricity.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma baakwasa buli catalyst ku electrode, ng’eno etambuza electron ezikolebwa, okusobola okukola amasannyalaze.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wá so amúṣedánwòyá kọ̀ọ̀kan mọ́ aṣètò ìgbéká agbára iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná, èyí tí ó jẹ́ aṣètò ajẹ́mọ́ná mọ̀nàmọ́ná tí ó máa ń gbé (ṣètò) agbára iná ti ó jẹyọ láti ara àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà, láti lè gbé iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná jáde.
Zulu: Babe sebenamathisela isilinganisi ngasinye lapho okuhamba khona ugesi, okuyinto kagesi ehambisa (eqhuba) ama-electron akhiqizwa ukusabela kwamakhemikhali, ukuze kukhiqizwe ugesi.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka maƙala kowane mai ƙara kuzari ga kwandaka, watau kwandakta da ke motsa (gudanar da) ilakturan da aka samu ta hanyar amsawar sinadarai, domin samar da wutar lantarki.
Northern Sotho: Ke moka ba kgomaretša sepotlakišakhemikhale se sengwe le se sengwe go eleketheroute, e lego sefehlamohlagase se se sepetšago (hlotlago) dielektrone tše di tšweletšwago ke phetogo ya khemikhale, gore go tšweletšwe mohlagase.
Amharic: ከዚያም ኤሌክትሪክን ለማምረት እያንዳንዱን ተንኳሽ በኬሚካዊ አፀግብሮት የሚመነጩትን ኤሌክትሮኖች ከሚያንቀሳቅሰው (ከሚያስተላልፈው) የኤሌክትሪክ አስተላላፊ ማለትም ኤሌክትሮድ ጋር አያይዘዋል።

English: In this case, the electrons came from a chemical reaction between sulphuric acid (H2S04) and a type of fuel called propylene glycol (the reaction is called the electrochemical oxidation of propylene glycol).
Luganda: Mu ngeri eno, electron zaava mu nkola za kemiya wakati wa sulphuric acid (H2S04) n’ekika ky’amafuta ekiyitibwa propylene glycol (enkola eyitibwa electrochemical oxidation of propylene glycol).
Yoruba: Nínú ìṣe èyí, àwọn agbára iná náà wá láti ara àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà láàrin ásíìdì ajẹmọ́sọ́fọ̀ (H2S04) àti oríṣìí epo tí wọ́n ń pè ní kẹ́míkà aṣètúká (àbáyọ náà ni wọ́n ń pè ní àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà onínàmọ̀nàmọ́ná ti kẹ́míkà aṣètúká).
Zulu: Kulokhu, ama-electron avela ekuphenduleni kwamakhemikhali phakathi kwe-sulfuric acid (H2S04) kanye nohlobo lwamafutha olubizwa ngokuthi i-propylene glycol (ukusabela kubizwa ngokuthi i-electrochemical oxidation ye-propylene glycol).
Hausa: A wannan yanayin, ilakturan sun fito ne daga wani nau’i na sinadarai tsakanin sulfuric acid (H2S04) da wani nau’in mai da ake kira propylene glycol (ana kiran amsawar da ƙona sinadarin lantarki na propylene glycol).
Northern Sotho: Mo tiragalong ye, dielektrone di be di etšwa go phetogo ya khemikhale magareng ga esiti ya salfariki (H2S04) le mohuta wa makhura ao a bitšwago propylene glycol (tiragalo ye e bitšwa oksideitšene ya elektrokhemikhale ya propylene glycol).
Amharic: በዚህ ሁኔታ ኤሌክትሮኖቹ የመጡት ከሰልፈሪክ አሲድ (H2S04) እና ፕሮፒሊን ግላይኮል ከተባለ የነዳጅ አይነት ኬሚካላዊ አፀግብሮት ሲሆን (ይህም አፀግብሮት የፕሮፒሊን ኤሌክትሮኬሚካል ግብአተ-ኦክሲጂን ይባላል)።

English: The researchers tested how much faster this reaction happened using their new catalysts compared to other zeolite catalysts.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagezesa obwangu bw’omulimu guno nga bakozesa catalyst zaabwe empya bw’ogeraageranya ne catalyst za zeolite endala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣàyẹ̀wò bí ó ṣe yára fún àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà láti wáyé nípa lílo èròjà amúṣedánwòyá wọn tuntun ní àfiwé pẹ̀lú àwọn èròjà amúṣedánwòyá síyóláìtì yòókù.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bahlole ukuthi lokhu kusabela kwenzeke ngokushesha okungakanani besebenzisa izilinganisi zabo ezintsha uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izilinganisi ze-zeolite.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gwada yadda wannan sauri ya faru ta hanyar amfani da sababbin abubuwan da suka haifar da ƙara kuzari idan aka kwatanta da sauran masu ƙara kuzarin zaulayit.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba dirile diteko tša gore phetogo ye e hlagile ka lebelo le kaakang go šomišwa dipotlakiši tše mpsha ge go bapetšwa le dipotlakiši tše dingwe tša zeolaete.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከሌሎች የዚዎላይት ተንኳሾች ጋር ሲነጻጸሩ አዲሶቹ ተንኳሾቻቸው በምን ያህል ፍጥነት ይህን አፀግብሮት እንደሚፈጥሩ ፈትሸዋል።

English: The researchers found that the reaction occurred much faster with added carbon nanotubes.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti omulimu gwayanguwa nnyo nga bagasseemu obuseke bwa kaboni.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ríi pé àáyọ ìdàpọ̀ náà wáyé kíákíá pẹ̀lú àfikún túùbù aláfẹ́fẹ́ kábọ̀n bíntín.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi ukusabela kwenzeka ngokushesha okukhulu ngama-carbon nanotubes angeziwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa amsawar ta faru da sauri tare da ƙarin raga.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore phetogo e hlagile ka lebelo kudu ka dinanotšhupu tša khapone tše di tšhetšwego.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የካርቦን ናኖ ቀሰሞች መታከል በእጅጉ ፈጣን አፀግብሮት እንደሚያመጣም ደርሰውበታል።

English: In fact, the more carbon nanotubes they used, the better the electrochemical oxidation of propylene glycol.
Luganda: Mu butuufu, obuseke bwa kaboni gye bwakoma obungi, gye baakoma okufuna electrochemical oxidation ya propylene glycol ennungi.
Yoruba: Ní pàtó, bí túùbù-bíntín aláfẹ́fẹ́ kábọ́ọ̀nù tí wọ́n lò bá ṣe pọ̀ sí, bẹ́ẹ̀ náà ni àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà onínàmọ̀nàmọ́ná ti kẹ́míkà aṣètúká.
Zulu: Eqinisweni, lapho besebenzisa ama-carbon nanotubes amaningi, iba ngcono i-electrochemical oxidation ye-propylene glycol.
Hausa: A haƙiƙa, yawancin raga ɗin da suke amfani da su, mafi kyawun ƙona sinadarin lantarki na propylene glycol.
Northern Sotho: Gabotsebotse, ge ba šomiša dinanotšhupu tša khapone ka bontši, ba tla hwetša oksideitšene ya elektrokhemikhale ya propylene glycol tše kaonekaone.
Amharic: እንደ እውነቱ ከሆነ የካርቦን ናኖ ቀሰሞችን በተጠቀሙ ቁጥር የፕሮፒሊን ግላይኮል ኤሌክትሮኬሚካል ግብአተ-ኦክሲጂን ይሻሻላል።

English: Silver nanoparticles also worked to speed up the reaction, which means this type of catalyst may be useful in future in very small electronic devices.
Luganda: Obutundutundu bwa feeza nabwo bwakola mu kwanguya omulimu, ekitegeeza nti catalyst ey’ekika kino eyinza okuyamba gye bujja mu byuma by’amasannyalaze ebitono ennyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn èérún-bíntín fàdákà náà tún ṣiṣẹ́ kóyá fún àbáyọ náà, èyí tí ó túmọ̀ sí pé irúfẹ̀ amúṣedánwòyá yìí lè wúlò lọ́jọ́-iwájú lára àwọn ohun-èlò tí ó ń lo iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná tí ó kéré gan-an.
Zulu: Ama-silver nanoparticles nawo asebenze ukusheshisa ukusabela, okusho ukuthi lolu hlobo lwesilinganisi lungaba usizo esikhathini esizayo kwimishini kagesi emincane kakhulu.
Hausa: Ɓangarori na azurfa kuma sun yi aiki don hanzarta amsawa, wanda suke nufin wannan nau’in mai ƙara kuzari na iya zama da amfani a nan gaba a cikin ƙananan na’urorin lantarki.
Northern Sotho: Dikarolwana tše nnyanenyane tša silibera le tšona di šomile go potlakiša phetogo, seo se šupago gore mohuta wo wa sepotlakišakhemikhale o ka ba mohola ka moso go didirišwa tše nnyanenyane tša elektroniki.
Amharic: የብር ናኖ ቅንጣቶችም አፀግብሮትን ለማፋጠን አገልግለዋል፤ ይህም ማለት እንዲህ አይነቱ ተንኳሽ ለወደፊቱ በጣም ትንሽ በሆኑ ኤሌክትሮኒክ መሳሪያዎች ውስጥ ጠቃሚ ሊሆን ይችላል።

English: Burning fossil fuels like coal, oil and natural gas to make electricity is harmful to the environment and contributes to our current climate change crisis.
Luganda: Okwokya ebyobugagga ebisimwa ng’amanda, amafuta ne gaasi ow’obutonde okukola amasannyalaze kya bulabe eri obutonde bw’ensi era kye kimu ku bivaako akatyabaga akaliwo ak’enkyukakyuka mu mbeera y’obudde.
Yoruba: Sísun àwọn epo abẹ̀mí tí wọ́n ń jò bí èédú, epo àti gáàsì láti pèsè iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná ń ṣe àkóbá fún àyíká ó sì ń dákún irúkèrúdò àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́ tí à ń kojú lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Ukushisa izibaso ezimbiwa phansi njengamalahle, uwoyela negesi yemvelo ukwenza ugesi kuyingozi kwimvelo futhi kunomthelela enkingeni yethu yamanje yokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.
Hausa: Ƙonewar ɓurɓushin halittu kamar gawayi da mai da kuma iskar gas domin samar da wutar lantarki yana da illa ga muhalli kuma yana haifar da rikicin canjin yanayi a halin yanzu.
Northern Sotho: Go tšhuma makhura a fosili a go swana le malahla, oli le kgase ya tlhago go tšweletša mohlagase go kotsi go tikologo ebile go baka mathata go phetogo ya klaemete ya bjale.
Amharic: ኤሌክትሪክን ለማግኘት እንደ ከሰል፣ ዘይት እና የተፈጥሮ ጋዝ የመሰሉ የቅሪተ አካል ነዳጆችን ማቃጠል ለአካባቢው ጎጂ ሲሆን አሁን ላለው የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ቀውስም አስተዋጽኦ አለው።

English: These fuels are also running out, since they are made from very old, fossilised and buried remains of plant and animal matter.
Luganda: Amafuta gano era gaggwaawo, olw’okuba nga gakolebwa okuva mu bisigalira by’ebimera n’ensolo ebyakaddiwa ennyo ne bifa ne biziikibwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn epo wọ̀nyí tún ti ń kásẹ nílẹ̀, níwọ̀n ìgbà tí ó jẹ́ pé láti ara àwọn irúgbìn tí wọ́n ti sin àti okù ẹranko ni wọ́n fi ṣe wọ́n.
Zulu: Lezi zinto zokubasa nazo ziyaphela, njengoba zenziwe ngezinsalela ezindala kakhulu, ezisamathambo nezigqitshiwe zezitshalo nezilwane.
Hausa: Su ma waɗannan man ɗin suna ƙarewa, tun da an yi su ne daga tsofaffin ɓurɓushi da kuma ragowar shuka da aka binne da kuma ƙwayoyin halitta na dabbobi.
Northern Sotho: Makhura a le ona a a hlaelela, ka ge a dirwa ka mašalela a dikarolo tša kgale, tše di nago le fosili tša dimela le diphoofolo tše di hwilego tša bolela mabung.
Amharic: እነዚህ ነዳጆች ለረጅም ጊዜ ተቀብረው ከነበሩ የእጽዋት እና የእንስሳት ቅሪተ አካላት የተሰሩ በመሆናቸው በማለቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ።

English: Fuel cells are a key alternative that scientists are looking at for electronic devices and cars.

Yoruba: Àwọn hóró epo jẹ́ àṣàyàn mìíràn tí ó ṣe kókó tí àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì ń wò fún àwọn ohun-èlò tí ó ń lo iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná àti àwọn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́.
Zulu: Amaseli kagesi ayindlela eyinhloko ososayensi abayibhekayo ukuze bathole izinto zikagesi nezimoto.
Hausa: Ƙwayoyin mai wata hanya ce ta madadin da masana kimiyya suke nema domin na’urorin lantarki da kuma motoci.
Northern Sotho: Disele tša makhura ke tsela ye nngwe ye bohlokwa yeo ditsebi tša saentshe di akanyago ka tšona go didirišwa tša elektroniki le mebotoro.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶች እየተመለከቷቸው ያሉት የነዳጅ ሴሎች ለኤሌክትሮኒክ መሳሪያዎች እና ለመኪናዎች ቁልፍ አማራጮች ናቸው።

English: Unlike batteries that store a certain amount of electricity that runs out with time, fuel cells continue to make electricity as long as there is fuel.
Luganda: Ng’oggyeeko baatule ezitereka ku masannyalaze naye nga gaggwaako oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera, amanda g’amafuta gasigala gakola amasannyalaze kasita amafuta gaba nga mwegali.
Yoruba: Yàtọ̀ bátìrì tí ó máa ń gba iye iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná kan sára tí yóò sì jó tán pẹ̀lú àkókò, àwọn hóró epo yóò máa pèsè iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná níwọ̀n ìgbà tí epo bá ti wà.
Zulu: Ngokungafani namabhethri agcina isilinganiso esithile sikagesi esiphelayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaseli kagesi ayaqhubeka enza ugesi inqobo nje uma kusekhona amafutha.
Hausa: Ba kamar batura masu adana adadin wutar lantarki da suke ƙarewa da lokaci ba, ƙwayoyin mai suna ci gaba da samar da wutar lantarki muddin akwai mai.
Northern Sotho: Go fapana le dipeteri tšeo di bolokago kelo ye itšego ya mohlagase wo o felago ge nako e le gare e sepela, disele tša makhura di tšwela pele go fehla mohlagase ge go na le makhura.
Amharic: ከጊዜ በኋላ የሚያልቅን የተወሰነ መጠን ያለው የኤሌክትሪክ መጠን ከሚያከማቹት ባትሪዎች በተለየ የነዳጅ ሴሎች ነዳጅ እስካለ ድረስ ኤሌክትሪክን መስራታቸውን ይቀጥላሉ።

English: In this study, researchers showed that it may be possible to improve fuel cell technology in future by using a zeolite catalyst mixed with nanomaterials.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baalaga nti kiyinza okusoboka okulongoosa tekinologiya w’amanda g’amafuta gye bujja nga bakozesa catalyst ya zeolite ng’egattiddwako nanomaterials.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí fi hàn ó lè ṣeé ṣe láti ṣe ìgbépẹ́ẹ́lí ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ hóró epo nípa lílo èròjà amúṣedánwòyá síyóláìtì tí wọ́n pò pọ̀ mọ́ àwọn ohun-èlò-bíńtín.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babonise ukuthi kungase kwenzeke ukuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bamaseli kagesi esikhathini esizayo ngokusebenzisa izilinganisi ze-zeolite  zixutshwe nama-nanomaterials.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu bincike sun nuna cewa yana iya yiwuwa a inganta fasahar mai a nan gaba ta hanyar yin amfani da abin da ake kira mai ƙara kuzarin zaulayit wanda aka haɗe da nanomaterials.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba bontšhitše gore go ka kgonagala go kaonafatša theknolotši ya disele tša makhura ka go šomiša sepotlakišakhemikhale sa zeolaete se se hlakantšwego le dimateriale tše nnyanenyane.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች በናኖ ቁሳቁሶች የተደባለቀ የዚዎላይት ተንኳሽ መጠቀም የወደፊቱን የነዳጅ ሴል ቴክኖሎጂን ሊያሻሽል እንደሚችል አሳይተዋል።

Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ilẹ̀ Egypt sọ pé àwọn ti ṣe ìgbépẹ́ẹ́lí èròjà amúṣedánwòlé kan tí ó lè jẹ́ lílò fún agbára-iṣẹ́ láti ara hóró-epo ní ọjọ́-iwájú.
Zulu: Abacwaningi base-Egypt bathi sebesithuthukisile isilinganisi esingasetshenziselwa amandla ahlanzekile avela kumakhemikhali kagesi esikhathini esizayo.
Hausa: Masu binciken na ƙasar Masar sun ce sun inganta wani abin da za a iya amfani da shi domin tsabtace makamashi daga ƙwayoyin man a nan gaba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba Egepeta ba bolela gore ba kaonafaditše go potlakišwa ga khemikhale go go ka šomišwago go hlwekiša enetši go tšwa go disele tša makhura ka moso.

English: They found that adding tiny silver particles and tiny carbon tubes to an existing catalyst significantly speeds up a chemical reaction involved in releasing energy from fuels.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti okuteeka obutundutundu bwa feeza obusirikitu n’obuseke bwa kaboni obutono mu catalyst esangiddwawo kyongeza nnyo ku nkola y’okufuna amasannyalaze okuva mu mafuta.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ríi pé ṣíṣàfikún àwọn èérún-bíntín fàdákà àti àwọn túùbù aláfẹ́fẹ́ kábọ́ọ̀nù mọ́ èròjà amúṣedánwòlé tí ó ti wà tẹ́lè láti túnbọ̀ mú kí àbáyọ ìdàpọ̀ kẹ́míkà tí ó wà lára gbígba agbára-ìṣe láti ara àwọn epo yá kánmọ́.
